name: Gift
overview: Scripture reveals that every good and perfect gift originates from God, the unchanging Father of lights, who graciously bestows blessings upon His people. Central to the Christian faith is the gift of salvation, described as a gift of God received by grace through faith, granting eternal life through Jesus Christ. Additionally, God imparts spiritual gifts, including the gift of the Holy Spirit, which believers receive upon repentance and baptism. These gifts and callings from God are irrevocable, underscoring His faithfulness and sovereign provision for His church.
